prompt: Create a saved comparison of viable cell density between CHO-007-R01 and CHO-007-R02 and summarize the numerical result. Use exact matching elapsed sample times and define differences as CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01. Report the mean signed difference, largest absolute difference, its elapsed time in hours, and name both batches. Include the deliveries still in review and state their provisional status.

output.content:
The comparison is saved. All 14 measured sample times matched exactly (elapsed 0–193 h), so no interpolation or aggregation was used.

**Result — viable cell density, difference defined as CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01, same measured elapsed time:**
- Mean signed difference: **−26,452 cells/mL** across 14 matched pairs (median −74,500 cells/mL; descriptive only, successive samples of one run are not independent so no significance test applies)
- Largest absolute difference: **+696,666 cells/mL at 169.0 elapsed hours**, where R02 was higher (6,783,333 vs 6,086,667 cells/mL)
- Batches compared: **CHO-007-R01** and **CHO-007-R02** (peak density reached 11,400,000 cells/mL in R01 at 138 h vs 11,066,667 in R02, also at 138 h)

**Deliveries still in review (all provisional — read from the delivery files, not yet reviewer-checked):**
- Northfield Biologics · November runs (CHO-007/008/009, both reactors) — the source of this comparison
- Northfield Biologics · October runs (CHO-004/005/006, both reactors)
- Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs (CHO-010/011/012, both reactors)

Because the November delivery is provisional, these values were read from the source files and have not been verified; the delivery carries open checks (mostly missing fields plus a duplicate conflict and layout changes) before it can be relied on. Batch context (product, process version, equipment, scale, stage) is not recorded in the delivery, so I cannot confirm the two runs share conditions.
